title: Open ClearPath Balance and the Professional Services Projects Deposit
content:
**Professional Services Projects — time-and-materials deposits for clients with an open ClearPath balance.**

When the balance due on the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is at least that agreement's monthly seat charge, its seat count multiplied by its seat rate and rounded half up to the cent, 5.0 percentage points are added to the deposit percentage; 2.5 points when the balance due is above zero but below that charge; and none when nothing is due or the client holds no active ClearPath agreement.

| Balance due on the active ClearPath agreement | Points added |
|---|---|
| at least the monthly seat charge | 5.0 |
| above zero, below the monthly seat charge | 2.5 |
| zero or less (nothing due) | none |
| no active ClearPath agreement | none |

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

An active ClearPath agreement covers 80 seats at a seat rate of 120.00, so its monthly seat charge is 9600.00. A balance due of 9600.00 adds 5.0 points; a balance due of 9599.99 adds 2.5 points; a balance due of 0.00 adds none.
